specs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production skeletal sprite atlas for the original 2009 Plants vs Zombies cartoon game, using the input ONLY as exact separate bone shapes and style reference. Old low-resolution softly painted 2D cartoon, irregular dark olive/brown outlines, muted but colorful flat shading, no realistic textures, no 3D, no shiny mobile-game polish. Actual transparent background. No text, grid, labels, assembled characters or shadows. Keep all pieces separate, their reading order, perspective, orientations and connector pads. New recognisable silhouettes and props, NOT just recolored existing characters. Preserve gray-green zombie skin. All sprites must read clearly when downsampled to 30-80 pixels. 2 columns x 2 rows. Upper left: small mushroom face/body facing right, with simple black oval eyes. Upper right: IDENTICAL face/body with closed eyes. Lower left: detached mushroom cap ONLY, no face or stem. Lower right: detached short stem connector ONLY. The cap overlaps the top of the separate face when assembled. Design a growing lightning mushroom stage 1 of 3. Young seedling: pale cream face, small sleepy smile, muted teal cap shaped as one rounded insulated bulb, one SHORT blunt pale-yellow lightning sprout growing from its top, broad cap brim. One simple dark-blue crescent gill below brim. Keep face and cap shading consistent and keep native attachment edges. Frame every part fully with empty margins.
